paper.title_en: Granular mass perturbations on the pulsar - supermassive black hole system
paper.abstract_en: Discovery and timing observations of a radio pulsar orbiting around Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole (SMBH) in our Galactic Centre (GC), will provide unprecedented opportunities of studying the SMBH spacetime, testing gravity theories, and probing the astrophysical environment in the GC. However, unknown mass distributions might cause timing residuals that are much larger than the timing precision. With extensive numerical simulations, for the first time we find that the perturbations caused by a granular cusp of stellar-mass black holes in the GC lead to post-fit timing residuals of 10-100 s--contrary to traditional wisdom--even for a pulsar in a tight orbit with an orbital period $P_b=0.5\,{\rm yr}$. Such a large timing residual can lead to significant measurement bias or even prevent construction of a phase-connected timing solution for the full orbit. We revisit the idea of extracting SMBH parameters only with data around periastron where the perturbation is small. Under the realistic phase-disconnected assumption, we point out that it is vital to consider the frame-dragging effect in the light propagation, which breaks parameter degeneracy and leads to an order of magnitude improvement for the measurement precision of the SMBH spin.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究脉冲星-超大质量黑洞系统中的颗粒状质量扰动，直接涉及脉冲星计时残余与黑洞时空参数测量，属于脉冲星计时阵列与引力基础理论交叉方向；采用大规模数值模拟定量给出10–100秒的后拟合计时残差，并讨论近星点数据提取黑洞参数及参考系拖曳效应在相位不连续情形下打破参数简并的作用，理论深度与方法信号较强，且对计时观测策略具有明确意义。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星-超大质量黑洞系统中的颗粒状质量扰动
decision.abstract_zh: 对一颗绕银河系中心（GC）超大质量黑洞（SMBH）人马座A*运行的射电脉冲星的发现与计时观测，将为研究SMBH时空、检验引力理论以及探测GC中的天体物理环境提供前所未有的机会。然而，未知的质量分布可能产生远大于计时精度的计时残差。通过大量数值模拟，我们首次发现，由GC中恒星质量黑洞组成的颗粒状核尖造成的扰动会导致10–100 s的后拟合计时残差——与传统看法相反——即使对于轨道周期$P_b=0.5\,{\rm yr}$的紧密轨道脉冲星也是如此。如此大的计时残差可能导致显著的测量偏差，甚至无法为整个轨道构建相位连续的计时解。我们重新审视仅利用近星点附近扰动较小的数据来提取SMBH参数的想法。在现实的相位不连续假设下，我们指出，考虑光传播中的参考系拖曳效应至关重要，它打破了参数简并，并使SMBH自旋测量精度提高一个数量级。
